# developer-hub

Red Hat Developer Hub (Backstage) internal developer portal

```yaml
stack:
  developerHub:
    enabled: true
```

## Operators

Each also renders `<name>-ns` and `<name>-status`. Pin with `operatorPolicies.<key>.versions` in a layer.

| Operator policy | Package | Channel | Source | Namespace | Versions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `install-rhdh` | `rhdh` | `fast-1.9` | `redhat-operators` | `rhdh-operator` | any |

## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: CM-2 Baseline Configuration. Categories: CM Configuration Management.

### Policy `install`

`install-developer-hub-<cluster>`: Install and manage Red Hat Developer Hub.

| Template | Action | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `install-developer-hub-ns-monitoring` | enforce | [ns-monitoring-label](converters/ns-monitoring-label.yaml) | Adds openshift.io/cluster-monitoring label to the operator namespace |
| `install-rhdh` | enforce | [operator](#operators) `rhdh` | Red Hat Developer Hub (Backstage) internal developer portal |
